value.meaning:
(41)(a) “Rent”
means any payment to be made to the landlord under the rental agreement,
periodic or otherwise, in exchange for the right of a tenant and any permitted
pet to occupy a dwelling unit to the exclusion of others and to use the
premises.
(b) “Rent” does
not include security deposits, fees or utility or service charges as described
in ORS 90.315 (4) and 90.562.
